mapper.select: SELECT H.BOOKSET_ID, H.HAPPEN_DATE, H.BOOK_DATE, bookdate.BOOKSET_DATE, bookset.STANDARD_CCY, H.TASK_ID, task.TASK_PRI, lay.busi_id as finprodId, lay.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE as finprodType, lay.BRANCH as branch, lay.BOK_DETAIL_ID as bokDetailId, lay.LAYERING_ID as layeringId FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO H INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bookset ON H.BOOKSET_ID = bookset.BOOKSET_ID INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE bookdate ON H.BOOKSET_ID = bookdate.BOOKSET_ID INNER JOIN SYS_BATCH_TASK task ON task.TASK_ID = H.TASK_ID INNER JOIN BOK_ACCT_LAYERING_INFO lay ON H.BOOKSET_ID = lay.bookset_id INNER JOIN PRD_BONUS_PLAN_N p ON p.finprod_id = lay.busi_id AND p.IS_NET_MORMALIZE = #{IS_NET_MORMALIZE} AND p.DEL_DATE = H.BOOK_DATE WHERE bookset.ACCT_MODE = #{acctMode} AND H.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND H.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND H.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND H.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND H.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND H.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET}
